note: Do tu trong container backend, dung dung prompt/schema import tu src/agents/slm.py. Bo sung cho deploy/vps/slm_classify_bench.py (tuan tu, N=1) va bao cao docs/reports/sp0-do-tre-tung-doan-2026-08-22.md (xen ke vai, mot client).

blind_spots.mot_may_mot_lan: MOT lan do tren MOT may. So de ra quyet dinh cau hinh, khong phai benchmark.
blind_spots.du_lieu_bi_cat_cut: Luot cham tran 30s duoc danh dau `cat_cut`. Gia tri that la '>= 30s, chua biet'. Moi o co `so_cat_cut > 0` thi p50/p95/max va ti le vuot tran deu la CAN DUOI.
blind_spots.p95_o_mau_nho_chinh_la_max: Voi `--vong 3`, muc N=1 chi co 3 mau nen 'p95' chinh la gia tri lon nhat. Dung doc no nhu mot phan vi that.
blind_spots.dong_thoi_khong_deu: N request ban ra gan nhu cung luc, KHONG mo phong nguoi dung that (ho den rai rac). Day la ca XAU NHAT, co y: cho tran tren cua do tre, khong cho ky vong trung binh.
blind_spots.lich_su_anh_huong_ket_qua: Do tre phu thuoc slot nao dang giu tien to nao, tuc phu thuoc vai phut TRUOC do. Hai run cung cau hinh co the lech 4x. Luon doc `so_lan_nap_nguoi` truoc khi so hai run.
blind_spots.khong_do_STT_TTS: Chi do llama-server. Luot that con qua STT/TTS - ca hai co khoa toan cuc (`voice.py:97`, `:192`, num_threads=1) nen cung noi tiep. Tong do tre se te hon.
blind_spots.n_predict_la_literal: `_N_PREDICT` chep tay tu `slm.py`. Doi n_predict o do ma quen o day thi script do mot cau hinh KHONG con ton tai. Kiem lai khi slm.py doi.
